sources.vendored_lines: 1-7400 (sections 0 to 13), with lines 122-127 (the sirilpy import block) replaced
intentional_divergences: Vendor the numerical core (sections 0 to 13) unchanged; replace section 14 (SirilIO) with AfterNightIO over an AfterNight image handle, and sections 15 and 16 (PyQt6 GUI, CLI) with a native Apply-only process window.
Read the FITS header from the image's AfterNight header cards (typed by parsing each card's raw record) instead of sirilpy, with keywords, HISTORY and DATE-OBS taken from the same cards.

Detect stars with AfterNight's star finder instead of Siril's findstar; its positions have the first pixel's centre at one half in storage order, so a detection is the position minus one half on both axes, with no row flip.

Keep the catalogue cache, the bright-star table and the last-output record in a package setting's folder (by default a per-user cache folder) instead of Siril's user data folder; local Siril catalogues can be named in the settings.
Use the core's top-hat channel responses, since Siril's SPCC preferences have no AfterNight counterpart; the core still fits a zero point and colour term on the image's own stars.
Without a dialog, soft refusals need Proceed Despite Warnings and an oversized download needs a higher download limit, as the upstream command line's -force and -maxdownload do.
Leave out PSF from a selection, which needs Siril's rectangle selection; measure or load a PSF instead.

Write integer images back in their own sample type, open the glow model as a new image instead of a file next to the input, and record the output's fingerprint in the cache folder to refuse a second subtraction.
Word the linear-WCS warning for AfterNight instead of Siril.
